Calculate community measures from a YAML experiment specification

Source: R/run_experiment_from_spec.R
get_community_measures_from_spec.Rd

Calculate community measures from a YAML experiment specification

Usage

get_community_measures_from_spec(
  experiment_folder,
  spec,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

experiment_folder

Folder containing experiment_table.RDS and where temperatures.db should be written.

spec

A YAML experiment specification path or specification object.

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, overwrite existing outputs.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, print progress messages.

Value

Invisibly returns the path to community_measures.RDS.
